types.name: attribute
types.description:
The attribute that the price preference refers to.

Current supported values: `region_id` and `currency_code`.

types.name: value
types.description:
The attribute's value. For example, if the `attribute` is `region_id`,
the value is a region's ID. Prices in that region use this price
preference.

types.name: is_tax_inclusive
types.description:
Whether prices matching this price preference have
taxes included in their amount.

types.name: created_at
types.description: The date that the price preference was created.

types.name: updated_at
types.description: The date that the price preference was updated.

types.name: deleted_at
types.description: The date that the price preference was deleted.
